name: AGX
recent: AGX 近期有多项董事及大股东持股变动公告，包括非执行董事 Penu Mark 在闭门期增持股份，以及执行董事 Dato' Ponnudorai 在闭门期外增持股份。此外，公司于 9 月发布新闻，提及推动航空航天物流业务以进入转型增长阶段。
notable: 非执行董事 Penu Mark 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日及 16 日增持公司股份。
执行董事 Dato' Ponnudorai A/L Periasamy 于 2026 年 10 月 9 日增持公司股份。
公司于 2026 年 9 月发布新闻，提及推动航空航天物流业务。

news.title: AGX enters transformative growth with aerospace logistics push

recent_en: AGX has recently seen several announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including non-executive director Penu Mark acquiring shares during the closed period and executive director Dato' Ponnudorai acquiring shares outside the closed period. In September, the company released news about pushing into aerospace logistics for transformative growth.
notable_en: Non-Executive Director Penu Mark acquired shares on 13 and 16 November 2026.
Executive Director Dato' Ponnudorai A/L Periasamy acquired shares on 9 October 2026.
The company released news in September 2026 about pushing into aerospace logistics.
